name: Arvadites
overview: The Arvadites are identified in Scripture as descendants of Canaan, part of the broader Canaanite families that spread across the region (Genesis 10:18). Ezekiel highlights their role as skilled mariners and warriors who supported the city of Tyre, serving as pilots and defenders on its walls, contributing to the city's strength and security (Ezekiel 27:8, 11). These verses reveal the Arvadites as a distinct people involved in both commerce and military defense during biblical times.
